Hi Ben,

sorry here is the missing vector.

label_select <- c("20km","50km","100km","5 Nearest Neigh.","10 Nearest Neigh.","15 Nearest Neigh.","Sphere of Influence","Gabriel Graph","Relative Graph","First Order Queen W","Second Order Queen W", "First Order Rook W","Second Order Rook W”)

aaa$AAA.sig <- aaa$AAA_b*aaa$p.value_logical
aaa$AAA.sig[aaa$AAA.sig==0] <- NA
col <- c(rainbow(13, s = 1, v = 1, start = 0, end = max(1, 13 - 1)/13, alpha = 1),"grey")
grey<-c(gray.colors(13,start=0.3,end=0.9,gamma=2.2))
ggplot(aaa, aes(x=Year))+
geom_line(aes(y=AAA_b,colour=factor(order_plot),size=factor(order_plot)),linetype="dotted")+
scale_size_manual(name="Contiguity Type",values = c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,1.2,0.5,0.5),labels=label_select,guide=guide_legend(nrow=7))+
geom_line(aes(y=AAA.sig,colour=factor(order_plot),size=factor(order_plot)),linetype=1)+

scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1990,1995,1998),limits=c(1990,1998))+
scale_colour_manual(name = 'Contiguity Type', values = col,labels=label_select,guide=guide_legend(nrow=7))+
scale_fill_discrete(name="legendName")+
labs(title="", x = "", y = "")+

scale_fill_continuous(guide = guide_legend())+facet_wrap(~label_var,ncol=3)

I have tried to suppress the legend manually (with guide_legend and guides), but wasn’t successful. In ‘plot’ I would simply create it manually through vectors, but in ggplot I am not sure how to proceed.

Ale

First, for simplicity, let's say

p <- ggplot(..) # everything except that third layer

Then, what about

p + geom_line(aes(y=AAA_c,size=factor(order_plot)),color='black',show_guide=F)

Note that (i) I've used show_guide, not show_legend, and (ii) moved
color='black' outside the aes() call.

Ben
